mods.name: Stats Search
mods.description: Adds a search box to the in-game Statistics screen so you can filter stats by name.

releases.notes:
Client-side Fabric mod for **Minecraft 26.3**.

Same features as the 26.2 build, now targeting Minecraft 26.3.

## Features
- **Search box** on the Statistics screen (Esc, then Statistics) that filters the General, Items, and Mobs lists by name as you type.
- **Pinned Items-tab column header** so the sort-button labels stay visible while you scroll, and still work for sorting.

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.3** on **Fabric Loader 0.19.5+**
- **Fabric API** 0.161.0+26.3 (or compatible)
- **Java 25**

## Install
Drop `statssearch-1.0.0+26.3.jar` into your `mods` folder alongside Fabric API.

Still on Minecraft 26.2? Use the [v1.0.0+26.2 release](https://github.com/Nate314/minecraft-stats-search/releases/tag/v1.0.0%2B26.2).
